svg.title: What I Build
svg.desc: Backend: Node.js, Express, REST APIs, layered architecture; Full Stack: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query; Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Drizzle ORM; AI Engineering: RAG, agents, tool calling, memory, query rewriting, LLM applications; GenAI: LangChain, LangGraph, Gemini, ChromaDB, LangSmith; Engineering: JWT, OAuth2, RBAC, multi-tenancy, Docker, AWS, CI/CD; Machine Learning: Scikit-learn, Random Forest, feature engineering, evaluation; DSA: C++, Array, Strings, Trees, graphs, DP, binary search, recursion, backtracking
